title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: usage reports for Copilot Search, connectors and agents in US Government clouds
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and the cited Microsoft documentation. The reporting paths and Graph operations are documented, and the page appropriately leaves government-release licensing and rollout defaults unconfirmed.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans new Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reports for Copilot Search, Copilot Connectors and Copilot Agents.
claims.quote: We are introducing new Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reports for Copilot Search, Copilot Connectors, and Copilot Agents for US Government customers

claims.where: front matter: clouds; summary; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The planned government release covers GCC Moderate, GCC High and DoD.
claims.quote: across GCC Moderate, GCC High, and DoD environments.

claims.claim: The planned reports provide administrators with organisation-level usage and adoption insights.
claims.quote: These reports will provide administrators with organization-level and user-level insights to help them understand usage and adoption of these Copilot capabilities.

claims.claim: The planned reports expose user-level usage insights to report readers.
claims.quote: These reports will provide administrators with organization-level and user-level insights to help them understand usage and adoption of these Copilot capabilities.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center exposes Copilot reporting under Reports > Usage > Microsoft Copilot.
claims.quote:
To view reports, go to Reports > Usage.
Select Microsoft Copilot > Readiness or Usage:

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments with principalId, roleDefinitionId and directoryScopeId '/' creates a general tenant-scoped Entra role assignment, rather than opening a report.

"directoryScopeId": "/"

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Viewing admin centre usage reports is controlled through administrator and reporting-reader roles.
claims.quote:
To view usage reports, you must have one of the following permissions:
Global Administrator
Exchange Administrator
SharePoint Administrator
Usage Summary Reports Reader (with no user details).
Reports Reader

claims.claim: The reporting options page lists AI Administrator as a role that accesses Copilot reports.
claims.quote: AI Administrator: Accesses the Copilot reports.

claims.claim: The tenant report-name concealment setting is at Settings > Org settings > Services > Reports > Conceal user, group, and site names in all reports.
claims.quote:
select Settings.
Select Org Settings.
On the Services tab, select Reports.
In the Reports panel, uncheck the checkbox next to Conceal user, group, and site names in all reports.

claims.claim: PATCH /beta/admin/reportSettings with displayConcealedNames set to true conceals identifying information in tenant reports.
Setting displayConcealedNames to false shows identifiable information.
claims.quote: If false, all reports show identifiable information.

claims.claim: Microsoft Graph beta APIs are subject to change.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version in Microsoft Graph are subject to change.

claims.claim: Use of Microsoft Graph beta APIs in production applications is not supported.
claims.quote: Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; controls[2].api; controls[2].note; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a government-specific UI or API switch for the new reports.
claims.quote: Searched: "reportSettings" "Copilot" "government"; "Copilot" "usage reports" "GCC" "enable". Opened reporting overview/options, Search and Connectors report pages and Graph adminReportSettings reference; no government-specific report switch documented.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the rollout default for this government reporting release.
claims.quote: Searched: "573170" "reports" default licensing rollout; "Copilot" "usage reports" "GCC" "enable". Read roadmap, reporting overview/options and Search, Connectors and Agents report pages; no government rollout default stated.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Licensing prerequisites specifically for the government reporting release have not yet been published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot" "usage reports" "government" "licensing". Opened Copilot license options, reporting overview/options and Search, Connectors and Agents report pages; product licensing documented, but no prerequisites specific to this government reporting release.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Tenant reporting privacy settings govern whether report readers see identifiable names.
claims.quote:
By default, all reports hide user information such as usernames, display names, groups, and sites to help companies support local privacy laws.
Global administrators can update the settings to display concealed information if your organization's privacy practices allow it.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents a Microsoft Copilot Agents usage report.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Copilot Agent usage report helps you track how agents are used in Microsoft Copilot Chat and Microsoft 365 apps - Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

claims.where: Governance controls: paragraph after table; Open questions: Metric definitions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed that the background Agents report's exact design and metrics describe this government release.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reports government Search connectors Agents December 2026 rollout metrics credits. Opened Agents report and reporting overview; read release-notes excerpts. No explicit mapping of exact metrics/design to this government release.

claims.quote: Searched: "573170" "reports" default licensing rollout; Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reports government Search connectors Agents December 2026 rollout metrics credits. Read roadmap, reporting overview and release-notes excerpts; no exact per-cloud dates.
